where.text:
Where the rate shows

• Transaction row: the rate against the base currency (exists), the rate between the two currencies of a transaction (new), the comment, and the amount in any currency other than the base one under the base amount.
• Details panel: the rate next to every ≈ amount in the base currency, and a Rate fact between the two currencies.
• Form: the rate next to the ≈ base amount hint, and a rate hint under the second amount of an expense, an income or a transfer in two currencies, and under the base currency amount of a balance adjustment.
• Accounts already show their rate (list, groups, details): unchanged.
